title: Face-to-Face Meeting with 3rd Years 2024｜Social Intelligence Laboratory, Ritsumeikan University

summary.lead: We had a face-to-face meeting with our third-year students!

overview: We had our first meeting with the new third-year students who were assigned to us in the fall semester! We had them eat pizza and socialize! We had the third-year students introduce themselves one by one. We had them create self-introduction cards with words related to themselves, and then they showed them to the others and asked questions, which is a tradition in our lab.🎵 We're looking forward to our new members joining us in the fall semester and making the lab even more lively!
